items.item_text: A resume is the only required attachment.

01. Please identify the highest level of education you have achieved. Options: No High School Diploma | High School Diploma or GED | Some College | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate
02. I understand that I must meet minimum qualifications to be considered for the position(s) I am interested in. Options: Yes
03. I understand that this is NOT a remote position and I will be required to work at the Butte College Main Campus for this temporary assignment. Options: Yes
04. Are you related to anyone at Butte College? If yes, please state who you are related to.
05. Are you currently a regular or non-regular employee of Butte College? Options: Regular employee (part-time) | Regular employee (full-time) | Non-regular employee

06. Residency/Work Eligibility Requirement: I understand that I may live outside of the State of California while participating in a recruitment process, however if am selected for a position, I must reside within the State to be eligible for district employment. In addition, work performed while working for the district, even remote work, must be done within the State of California. I also understand that the Butte-Glenn Community College District does not provide US visa or employment sponsorship. Options: Yes
Bachelor’s degree* in accounting, finance, business administration, or public administration; AND
Five (5) years of increasingly responsible financial and accounting experience including detailed financial reporting; AND
One (1) year of management and/or supervisory level experience directly related to the responsibilities in this class; AND
Direct experience coordinating and preparing Annual Financial Audit Reports and implementing new accounting standards; OR
Any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Click the (apply) button above and submit a complete online application. Please fill out all the application fields thoroughly. Your application should contain the most up to date and accurate information regarding your work history.
Only applicants who meet the minimum qualifications for an open temporary vacancy and are selected for an interview by the department will be contacted.
If you have questions or would like to check the status of your application, you can contact Human Resources at humanre@butte.edu .
